title: 第13章 绒袋收灵草 巧制铁木兵第14章 玄铁锻枪尖 林猎钢牙猪
lines: 午后的阳光透过层层叠叠的枝叶，洒在碧叶林西侧的柔藤漫坡之上。
林间暖风轻拂，藤蔓随风轻摆，空气中还残留着篝火与灵肉的淡淡余香。
罗止正将绒尾灵犬皮平铺在草地上，又取过早已抽出的几缕坚韧兽筋。
他从火堆旁捡起一截细小坚硬的兽骨，用腰间的骨刀细细削磨，片刻便做成一枚简易实用的兽骨针。
跟着拿起一根兽筋，小心穿入针孔，拉紧捋顺。
他穿针引线，一针一线认真缝合兽皮，针脚扎实紧密。不多时，一只方整紧致、大小适中的兽皮储物袋便缝制完成。
罗止正看着成品，神色淡然，轻声开口：“以后便叫它绒纹储物袋吧。”
他随手将兽骨针收好，揣回腰间，以备后用。
随后拿起绒纹储物袋，走到李紫云身旁，抬手轻轻系在她腰间，细致调整到最顺手舒适的位置。
李紫云轻抚腰间新袋，眉眼弯弯，语气满是欣喜：“真好看，有了它，以后装草药就方便多了。”
有了储物袋，两人便并肩在柔藤漫坡间缓步搜寻起来。
坡间草木葱茏，灵气弥漫，灵草大多藏在藤蔓之下、石块缝隙之中，需要仔细分辨才能寻得。
没走多远，罗止正率先在一片青苔旁停下，弯腰缓缓拨开杂草，一株叶片碧绿的灵草显露出来。
这正是碧叶灵心草，凡阶一阶灵草。
能快速愈合伤口，稳定体内灵气，大幅缓解疲惫，药性清凉温和，入口微甜，可助迅速恢复伤痛、体力与耗损的灵力。
罗止正目光落在灵草上，语气平静：“这里有一株碧叶灵心草。”
他小心将灵草采下，抬手递给李紫云。李紫云笑着接过，喜滋滋地收入绒纹储物袋中。
两人继续向前搜寻。
片刻后，李紫云忽然眼前一亮，指着不远处的石缝轻呼出声。
李紫云神色惊喜，连忙扬声唤道：“罗止正，快看，这里还有一株！”
罗止正快步走近查看，微微颔首，俯身将其采下递给她。
就这样一路走走停停，时而罗止正先发现，时而李紫云先找到，碧叶灵心草零零散散被他们一一收入袋中。
又行一段，李紫云在一处湿润阴凉的角落顿住脚步，一株覆着淡蓝霜雾、花心淡紫的灵草映入眼帘。
这正是玄霜蝶心草，同样是凡级一阶灵草。
可快速愈合皮肉外伤，稳定紊乱灵气，缓解身心疲惫，亦能解除部分凡毒与轻微瘴气，药性温和，适合日常疗伤之用。
李紫云眼睛一亮，语气雀跃地叫道：“止正，快过来！”
罗止正快步走到李紫云身旁，顺着她的目光望去。
湿润阴凉的角落，一株灵草亭亭生在草丛间，茎秆淡青莹润，叶片对称舒展如蝶翼，边缘萦绕着一层淡淡霜白柔光，中心一点浅紫细蕊轻轻颤动，远远望去，便似一只停落枝头的冰蝶。
罗止正微微讶异，低呼一声：“这是玄霜蝶心草！”
两人刚将这株玄霜蝶心草采下，李紫云目光一转，又在不远处的藤蔓下发现了一株同类。
李紫云神色欢喜，高声叫道：“那边还有一株！这边也有！”
她快步上前，小心翼翼地将其采下，脸上满是收获的喜悦。
一路搜寻下来，绒纹储物袋已装下小半袋灵草，足够两人用一段时间。
两人稍作休整，罗止正随即抬眼，望向碧叶林北面那片地势微微隆起的方向。
李紫云顺着他的目光望去，神色担忧，声音放轻：“你……要往那边走？”
罗止正微微颔首，语气平静却带着不容置疑的笃定：“我们回去盘根石岗。”
李紫云心头一惊，连忙伸手拉住他衣袖，眉眼间满是不安：“回去？那里那么危险，我们好不容易才……”
罗止正低头看了眼她轻攥自己衣袖的手，心头微暖，语气放缓安抚：“我们必须继续探索盘根石岗。”
content_en:
The afternoon sun shines through the layers of branches and leaves on the soft vine slopes on the west side of the green leaf forest.
The warm breeze blew gently in the forest, the vines swayed gently in the wind, and the faint fragrance of the campfire and spiritual flesh still lingered in the air.
Luo Zhi was spreading the downy-tailed spirit dog skin on the grass, and took out a few strands of tough animal sinew that had been pulled out earlier.
He picked up a small, hard animal bone from beside the fire, sharpened it with the bone knife on his waist, and made a simple and practical animal bone needle in a moment.
Then pick up a piece of animal tendon, carefully insert it into the needle hole, tighten it and smooth it out.
He threaded the needle and stitched the animal hide carefully, stitch by stitch, and the stitches were solid and tight. In a short time, a square, compact and medium-sized animal skin storage bag was sewn.
Luo Zhi was looking at the finished product with an indifferent expression and said softly: "Let's call it a velvet storage bag from now on."
He casually put the animal bone needle away and put it back on his waist for later use.
Then he picked up the velvet storage bag, walked to Li Ziyun, raised his hand and tied it gently around her waist, carefully adjusting it to the most comfortable and comfortable position.
Li Ziyun caressed the new bag on his waist, his eyebrows curved, and his tone was full of joy: "It's so beautiful. With it, it will be much more convenient to carry herbs in the future."
With the storage bag in hand, the two of them started searching side by side among the soft vine slopes.
The slopes are covered with verdant vegetation and filled with spiritual energy. Most of the spiritual herbs are hidden under the vines and in the gaps between the rocks. You need to carefully identify them to find them.
Not far away, Luo Zhizheng took the lead and stopped next to a piece of moss. He bent down and slowly pushed aside the weeds, revealing a spiritual grass with green leaves.
This is the Blue Leaf Spiritual Heart Grass, a first-order mortal-level spiritual grass.
It can quickly heal wounds, stabilize the spiritual energy in the body, and greatly relieve fatigue. The medicinal properties are cool and mild, and the taste is slightly sweet. It can help quickly restore pain, physical strength, and depleted spiritual energy.
Luo Zhizheng's eyes fell on the spiritual grass and his tone was calm: "There is a green-leaf spiritual heart grass here."
He carefully picked the spiritual grass and handed it to Li Ziyun. Li Ziyun took it with a smile and happily put it into a velvet storage bag.
The two continued to search forward.
After a moment, Li Ziyun's eyes suddenly lit up, he pointed at the crack in the stone not far away and exhaled softly.
Li Ziyun looked surprised and shouted quickly: "Luo Zhizheng, look, there is another one here!"
Luo Zhizheng walked quickly to check it out, nodded slightly, leaned over and picked it up and handed it to her.
Just walking and stopping like this, sometimes Luo Zhizheng found it first, sometimes Li Ziyun found it first, and the scattered Green Heart Grasses were put into their bags one by one.
After walking for a while, Li Ziyun stopped in a moist and cool corner, and a spiritual grass covered with light blue frost mist and a lavender center came into view.
This is Xuan Shuang Butterfly Heart Grass, which is also a first-level mortal level spiritual grass.
It can quickly heal skin and flesh wounds, stabilize disordered spiritual energy, relieve physical and mental fatigue, and can also relieve some common poisons and minor miasma. It has mild medicinal properties and is suitable for daily healing.
Li Ziyun's eyes lit up and he shouted excitedly: "Zhizheng, come here quickly!"
Luo Zhizheng walked quickly to Li Ziyun and followed her gaze.
In a moist and cool corner, a spiritual grass grows among the grass. The stems are light green and shiny, and the leaves are symmetrically stretched like butterfly wings. There is a layer of soft frosty white light around the edges. A small light purple stamen in the center trembles gently. From a distance, it looks like an ice butterfly sitting on a branch.
Luo Zhizheng was slightly surprised and whispered: "This is the Black Frost Butterfly Heart Grass!"
The two of them had just picked the Black Frost Butterfly Heart Grass when Li Ziyun turned his eyes and found another similar plant under the vines not far away.
Li Ziyun looked happy and shouted loudly: "There is another one over there! There is one over here too!"
She quickly stepped forward and carefully picked it, her face full of joy of harvest.
After searching all the way, the velvet storage bag has contained a small half bag of spiritual herbs, which is enough for two people to use for a while.
The two of them rested for a while, and Luo Zhizheng immediately raised his eyes and looked in the direction of the slightly raised terrain to the north of the Biye Forest.
Li Ziyun followed his gaze, looking worried and speaking softly: "You...are you going to go there?"
Luo Zhizheng nodded slightly, his tone calm but with unquestionable certainty: "Let's go back to Pangenshigang."
Li Ziyun was startled, and quickly stretched out his hand to hold his sleeve, his eyebrows full of uneasiness: "Go back? It's so dangerous there, we finally managed to..."
Luo Zhizheng lowered his head and glanced at her hand that was lightly grasping his sleeve. His heart warmed slightly, and his tone softened and comforted: "We must continue to explore Pangenshigan."
title_en: Chapter 13: Collection of Spiritual Grasses in Velvet Bags, Skillful Making of Iron Wood Soldiers, Chapter 14: Black Iron Forged Spear Point, Lin Hunting Steel Tusk Pigs
